newsitem.title: UK: WPP raises interest in CIA Group.
newsitem.headline: WPP raises interest in CIA Group.

text.p: Advertising and marketing group WPP Group Plc said on Friday it had acquired another 1.8 million shares in media company CIA Group Plc.
WPP has now raised its interest in CIA to 7.8 million shares representing 12.8 percent of its issued share capital.

CIA, Europe's second largest independent media buying, planning and research agency, has denied that it was interested in selling the company, saying it was keen to form alliances as part of its growth strategy.
CIA's share price was slightly up -- by 1-1/2 pence -- at 184p by 1215 GMT.
